actions.desc: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Detect Magic, Light, Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation

actions.name: 2/Day Each
actions.desc: Fireball (level 4 version), Invisibility

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Cone of Cold, Fly

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: The mage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning.

bonus_actions.name: Ignited Illumination
bonus_actions.desc: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

special_abilities.name: Demonic Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Reactive
special_abilities.desc: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition. Mephits

actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Ocean Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the merfolk’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The merrow can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow’s next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

special_abilities.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

actions.name: Abyssal Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gore (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition. Mummies

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this mummy’s Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_abilities.desc: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Undead Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy’s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Channel Negative Energy
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague (level 7 version)

reactions.name: Whirlwind of Sand
reactions.desc: Trigger: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Response: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Dread Command
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Glare
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Necrotic Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mammoth makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the mammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Trample
bonus_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

special_abilities.name: Compression
special_abilities.desc: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
